statements.statement: The patient presents with a history of recurrent, unexplained episodes of syncope and presyncope
There is concern for an underlying paroxysmal cardiac arrhythmia
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was for extended ambulatory assessment
The diagnosis codes are I49.9 and R55
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
